_doc: Curated portability verdicts that a mechanical sweep cannot derive: the technique triage already recorded in docs/research/PatchStorageBestOf.md, plus licence facts that live outside the repo metadata. Key = normalised coverage key (see README.md). build_coverage.py reads this file if present and adds `verdict`/`verdict_reason` to every row.

words.reason: label-only text mode, no technique to port (docs/research/PatchStorageBestOf.md: not worth porting)

branded-backdrop.reason: cycling text phrases / branding, not a procedural scene (docs/research/PatchStorageBestOf.md)

smpte-standby.reason: SMPTE colour-bar test pattern; date/broadcast-specific, not a library scene (docs/research/PatchStorageBestOf.md)

hertsi.reason: source of record is Codeberg twang69/hertsi, EUPL-1.2 (the PatchStorage upload states no licence text); copyleft — a port inherits EUPL

strange-attractor.reason: bespoke scene lorenz-trail is the Lorenz attractor already in our library (eyesy-modes-bespoke README batch-1 table); a stock-library port of the pysey patch is still owed

whitney-fans.reason: bespoke scene whitney-kaleido covers the Whitney fan technique (eyesy-modes-bespoke README batch-1 table)

chladni-resonance.reason: bespoke scene chladni-plate covers the Chladni cymatics technique (eyesy-modes-bespoke README batch-1 table)
